Dazzle Mart — Bangladesh’s Ultimate Electronics Hypermarket


Experience Technology. Explore Everything.


Welcome to Dazzle Mart, a premium electronics hypermarket by Dazzle, created to redefine the way Bangladesh experiences technology and electronics.
Located at Bashundhara City Shopping Mall, Level 7 (Gold Floor), Dazzle Mart brings an extensive collection of smartphones, laptops, tablets, TVs, home appliances, smart devices, audio products, gaming products, gadgets and much more—all under one roof. (dazzle.com.bd)


Designed as a luxury shopping destination, Dazzle Mart is more than just an electronics store. It is a place where customers can see, touch, compare and experience products before making a purchase.


🇧🇩 A New Standard for Electronics Shopping


Dazzle Mart is built around one simple idea: premium products deserve a premium shopping experience.


With a wide range of global brands and multiple product categories, customers can explore everything from the latest flagship smartphones to laptops, televisions, air conditioners, air purifiers, hair dryers, sound systems and smart lifestyle products.


Our collection includes leading brands such as:
Apple • Samsung • Xiaomi • HONOR • Google • OnePlus • Vivo • OPPO • Huawei • Nothing • iQOO • realme • Lenovo • ASUS • HP • Dell • Acer • MSI • Microsoft • JBL • Sony • Dyson • DJI and many more.


Brand and model availability may vary depending on current stock.


🛍️ Everything Under One Roof


At Dazzle Mart, customers can explore:
📱 Smartphones & Flagship Phones

💻 Laptops & MacBooks

📲 iPads & Tablets

⌚ Smartwatches & Wearables

🎧 Headphones, Earbuds & Audio

📺 Smart TVs & Entertainment

❄️ Air Conditioners & Cooling Solutions

🌬️ Air Purifiers

💨 Hair Dryers & Personal Care Electronics

🔊 Speakers & Sound Systems

🎮 Gaming Devices & Accessories

📷 Cameras & Drones

🏠 Smart Home & Lifestyle Electronics

🔌 Chargers, Accessories & Tech Essentials


✨ Premium Live Experience


At Dazzle Mart, customers don’t have to rely only on pictures or specifications. Experience the products yourself.
Our spacious showroom allows customers to explore products physically, compare different models and understand their features before making a purchase.
Whether you’re looking for your next iPhone, Galaxy flagship, MacBook, gaming laptop, TV, sound system or smart home device, Dazzle Mart is designed to make the entire experience easier, more comfortable and more premium.


🛡️ Dazzle Services
Dazzle goes beyond product sales with a complete customer-care ecosystem, including:
Dazzle Care+ (DC+) Additional protection and replacement benefits available with eligible products.
BuyBack Care+ A dedicated buyback solution designed to provide customers with future upgrade flexibility.
EMI Facilities Flexible EMI options are available on eligible products and campaigns.
Exchange / Trade-In Customers can explore exchange opportunities for eligible devices.
Nationwide Delivery Dazzle provides delivery services across Bangladesh.


Online Booking & Shop Pickup Check availability online, book your desired product and collect it from a Dazzle outlet.
Customer Care & After-Sales Support Dazzle also provides dedicated customer support and after-sales services through its customer-care ecosystem.


👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 A Shopping Destination for Everyone


Dazzle Mart is designed not only for technology enthusiasts, but for the entire family.
From a student looking for a laptop to a professional upgrading to a flagship smartphone, or a family looking for a new TV, AC or home appliance—Dazzle Mart brings multiple technology needs together in one destination.

/shop-location/finlay-square-shopping-ma.title: Finlay Branch Store
/shop-location/finlay-square-shopping-ma.description: Facilities: • Wide Variety of Smartphones: From flagship devices to budget-friendly options, customers can find the latest models from top brands. • Premium Gadgets and Accessories: Along with smartphones, Dazzle offers premium gadgets such as smartwatches, wireless earbuds, and accessories like Spigen and Caselogy. • Warranty Services: Customers can avail of free parts warranties and exclusive Dazzle Care+ services for Apple products, ensuring top-notch after-sales support. • Exchange Offers: Dazzle provides exchange offers, allowing customers to trade in their old devices for the latest models. • Free Delivery: Customers enjoy free delivery services across Bangladesh. • Easy EMI Facilities: To make purchases more accessible, Dazzle offers EMI options for customers. Location: • Address: Shop No. 414 & 429, 4th floor, Finlay Square, East Nasirabad, Chittagong. Directions: Dazzle Finlay Square Branch is located in East Nasirabad, Chittagong, inside Finlay Square Mall. The outlet is on the 4th floor, easily accessible from any part of the city. Visitors can reach the branch via major roads like Bayezid Bostami Road or use public transportation that stops near the mall.

/shop-location/jamuna-future-park-branch.title: Jamuna Future Park Store
/shop-location/jamuna-future-park-branch.description: The Dazzle Jamuna Future Park Branch is one of Dazzle’s flagship stores in Dhaka, offering an extensive selection of the latest smartphones, gadgets, and accessories. Located in one of the largest shopping malls in South Asia, this branch is the perfect destination for technology enthusiasts looking for high-quality products and exceptional service. Facilities: • Latest Smartphones: The branch offers a vast collection of smartphones from top brands like Apple, Samsung, Xiaomi, Motorola, and more, providing customers with the latest models at competitive prices. • Branded Gadgets & Accessories: Dazzle stocks a wide range of premium gadgets such as smartwatches, wireless earbuds, and high-end accessories from brands like JBL, Bose, Spigen, and Caselogy. • Warranty & After-Sales Service: Customers can avail free parts warranties and enjoy Dazzle Care+, a premium service for Apple products that ensures brand-new replacements for certain issues. • Exchange & EMI Offers: Dazzle provides exchange offers, allowing customers to trade in their old phones for new ones, along with easy EMI facilities for convenient payment options. • Free Delivery: The branch offers free nationwide delivery, ensuring a seamless shopping experience. • Expert Customer Service: The store’s trained staff are always available to assist customers in making the right purchase decision, ensuring a pleasant shopping experience. Location: • Address: Shop No. 021C & 021D, North Court, Block - B, 4th floor, Jamuna Future Park, Kuril Pragoti Shoroni, Dhaka. Directions: Dazzle’s Jamuna Future Park Branch is situated on the 4th floor of the North Court, Block B, inside Jamuna Future Park Mall. The mall is located on Kuril Pragoti Shoroni, Dhaka, and is easily accessible via major roads, including the Airport Road. Visitors can also use public transport or ridesharing services for easy access to the mall. Ample parking is available for those driving to the location.
